shot: Hero shot: silver cross pendant / store facade
title: CHROME HEARTS
rows: From an LA garage to a cult silver house.
Seven pieces worth knowing before you buy.

title: BORN IN LA, 1988
rows: He couldn't find riding leathers he liked.
So he made his own, silver hardware and all.

title: THE RULES
rows: Built by craftspeople in its own LA workshop.
Almost no ads, just a few select stores.
end: Hard to find is part of the appeal.

title: CROSS PENDANT
rows: The cross is the house signature.
Gothic, heavy and made to be layered.
Silver darkens over time and gets better.
end: The easiest way into the brand.

shot: Stack of silver rings on hand
title: SILVER RINGS
rows: A slim band that stacks with anything.
For when you want a statement.
end: Start slim, then build your stack.

title: LEATHER
rows: Where it all began: biker leathers.
Silver buttons, snaps and zip pulls.
Cross patches down the leg, pure CH.
end: The brand's DNA, in its rawest form.

title: EYEWEAR
rows: Silver crosses and gothic hardware on the arms.
end: The most visible way to wear CH.

title: APPAREL
rows: Tees, hoodies, trucker caps and denim.
Even furniture and homeware get the CH touch.

shot: Store interior / flat lay of pieces
title: WHERE TO START
rows: A simple ring or a small pendant.
A logo tee or a pair of frames.
A leather jacket with silver hardware.
